parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the DRDS database.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the DRDS instance.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time for executing the flashback SQL.

parameters.name: RecallRestoreType
parameters.description:
The restore type. Valid values:
* 1: image restore.
* 0: reverse restore.

parameters.name: RecallType
parameters.description:
The match type. Valid values:
* 0: exact match.
* 1: fuzzy match.

parameters.name: SqlPk
parameters.description: The primary key of the flashback SQL.

parameters.name: SqlType
parameters.description: The type of SQL statement. Valid values: INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE. Separate multiple values with commas (,).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time for executing the flashback SQL.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The name of the table on which the flashback SQL operation is performed.

parameters.name: TraceId
parameters.description: The trace ID of the flashback SQL.
